items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: there's a good boy named Chicken... We used to go there... I'd have my bass, and I'd sit down, just play

ctx.x: Yeah. Like when you were a kid,

children? Yeah, madeline, guitar and bass. Just serenading, going on a serenading, you know. Go around the house, having good times, you know, go in one of those houses, sit on there, there's a good boy named Chicken, and Arthur Banks, uh-uh, Arthur, yeah. We used to go there, his wife played guitar, he played madeline, and I'd have my bass, and I'd sit down, just play, you know.
